svg.title: claude-workhorses: wh runs a repository's tests on a workhorse, under the plugin's horse
svg.desc: A terminal runs wh in a small Go repository. The first run picks the workhorse alpha, copies every file and runs the tests. After a one-line edit, the second run sends only the edited file. Each state lasts 2.5 seconds.
svg.metadata: {"title":"wh runs a repository's tests on a workhorse, then runs them again after an edit","description":"A terminal runs wh in a small Go repository. The first run picks the workhorse alpha, copies every file and runs the tests. After a one-line edit, the second run sends only the edited file. Each state lasts 2.5 seconds.","provenance":{"checkout_head":"1dedbc8ffb903dee551a95f4e6095ff4aea92547","host":"alpha, a real workhorse; its ssh target stays outside the capture","versions":{"host":{"arch":"x86_64","cores":6,"ram_gb":16},"go":"go version go1.27.4 darwin/amd64"},"commands":["wh -- gtimeout 5m go test -v ./...","echo 'func TestSub(t *testing.T) { if Sub(5, 3) != 2 { t.Fatal(\"Sub(5, 3) != 2\") } }' >> calc_test.go","wh -- gtimeout 5m go test -v ./..."],"capture_commands":["bash assets/capture/wh-run.sh","tmux -L svgcap capture-pane -p -e"],"crop":"Each file holds only the rows its frame shows, captured with -S and -E; all 110 columns remain.","themes":"One capture serves both themes; the shell prints no colors of its own.","terminal_defaults":{"light":["#302a24","#fbf6e9"],"dark":["#eeeeee","#191919"]},"home_path":"The current home directory prefix is replaced with ~ when capture files are written."},"frames":[{"label":"wh sends the tests to a workhorse","captures":{"dark":{"file":"wh-run-0-dark.ansi","crop":[0,1],"sha256":"b7db8849e641612aa2da81dfe3695ac451335e0b7f8fa1cfc0c4152d74454799"},"light":{"file":"wh-run-0-dark.ansi","crop":[0,1],"sha256":"b7db8849e641612aa2da81dfe3695ac451335e0b7f8fa1cfc0c4152d74454799"}}},{"label":"The first run copies every file","captures":{"dark":{"file":"wh-run-1-dark.ansi","crop":[0,5],"sha256":"08866ee0688ec3084ab12e912f4abe2bdb12a37e85418371505a44b15abc4b69"},"light":{"file":"wh-run-1-dark.ansi","crop":[0,5],"sha256":"08866ee0688ec3084ab12e912f4abe2bdb12a37e85418371505a44b15abc4b69"}}},{"label":"The tests pass, and wh exits with their exit code","captures":{"dark":{"file":"wh-run-2-dark.ansi","crop":[0,14],"sha256":"e15235951ca0ba8f1593724fad2c4318ea83b45cdf97ee15036efcef989bd97a"},"light":{"file":"wh-run-2-dark.ansi","crop":[0,14],"sha256":"e15235951ca0ba8f1593724fad2c4318ea83b45cdf97ee15036efcef989bd97a"}}},{"label":"An edit, then the same command","captures":{"dark":{"file":"wh-run-3-dark.ansi","crop":[0,16],"sha256":"5c979570c87a82746922cdfedade703d2414900234a32677f35a04dbde9db436"},"light":{"file":"wh-run-3-dark.ansi","crop":[0,16],"sha256":"5c979570c87a82746922cdfedade703d2414900234a32677f35a04dbde9db436"}}},{"label":"The second run sends only the edited file","captures":{"dark":{"file":"wh-run-4-dark.ansi","crop":[0,28],"sha256":"8ffd89e97cb52d2ab54094036c7732cf517d5e2ab848465538662ed568712a2a"},"light":{"file":"wh-run-4-dark.ansi","crop":[0,28],"sha256":"8ffd89e97cb52d2ab54094036c7732cf517d5e2ab848465538662ed568712a2a"}}}],"columns":110,"seconds_per_frame":2.5,"layout":{"font":13,"cell":7.8,"line":22,"padding":24}}
